clue.text: Female took control and escaped

parts.note: to have led is to have taken control, been in charge

explanation.surface: A woman seizes command of the situation and gets away.
explanation.definitionFit: To have fled is to have run away from danger, so it is a synonym of escaped.

clue.text: A white substance lying under black rock

indicators.note: in a down answer, pieces lying under another are written after it

parts.note: B is the pencil-grading abbreviation for black
salt is a familiar white crystalline substance

explanation.surface: Some pale deposit sits beneath a dark stone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying under' places A and SALT beneath B, which in a down entry means after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Basalt is a dark volcanic stone, one kind of rock.

clue.text: Woman going to party with old dress on — problem with not being young

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name
a do is an informal word for a party or celebration
a mini is a short dress, put on after the other pieces

explanation.surface: A woman heads to a party wearing a vintage frock.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage the Latin dating phrase also stands for advancing years, the complaint of no longer being young.
explanation.definitionFit: Used humorously, the Latin dating phrase means advancing age, the trouble of no longer being youthful.

clue.text: Said to have begun right away

indicators.note: away tells us the letter for right is sent off from the word for begun

parts.note: started means to have begun

explanation.surface: It is reported that something got going at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' looks like 'immediately' but splits: R (right) goes away from STARTED.
explanation.definitionFit: Stated is a past form meaning declared or spoken, so a synonym of said.

clue.text: Bashful star

parts.note: Bashful, one of Snow White's seven dwarfs, would blush, making him a crimson little one; the star is a small cool astronomical body

explanation.surface: A shy celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: Bashful is one of the seven dwarfs in Disney's Snow White; a shy one turns red, and the real term names a small, cool star.
explanation.definitionFit: The astronomical term names a small, cool, dim star, while the pun reads it as a blushing little man.

clue.text: Port remaining in the glass?

definitions.meaning: port is the nautical term for the ...-hand side of a ship
wine still in the glass is what has been not drunk, what remains

explanation.surface: Some fortified wine is still sitting in the glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the wine, which the glass supports, but it is the side of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Port is the side of a vessel opposite starboard, and what remains has been not taken.

clue.text: Table cover needed with proper game being held

indicators.note: being held says the board game sits inside the word for proper

parts.note: due means proper or fitting, as in due respect
chess is a board game

explanation.surface: A tablecloth is required for a correctly played board game.
explanation.definitionFit: A duchesse is an embroidered cloth laid on a dressing table.

clue.text: Lad meaning to become a top performer

indicators.note: to become means these letters change into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A young man intends to be a star actor.
explanation.definitionFit: The leading man is the chief male actor in a play or film, its star performer.

clue.text: Discover bank holds rand

indicators.note: holds says the word for bank wraps round the currency letter

parts.note: an aircraft banks or leans when turning
R is the abbreviation for the rand, South Africa's currency

explanation.surface: Find out that the bank keeps South African money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks like a financial institution, but it is the verb, to tilt.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn something is to find it out, so it is a synonym of discover.

clue.text: Programme notes

parts.note: reads like printed notes in a theatre programme, but means the musical notes that identify a broadcast show

explanation.surface: The printed notes in a theatre programme.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme tune is the signature music played at the start of a television or radio show.

clue.text: Carry on with doctor when having a disease!

parts.note: gout is a painful joint disease

explanation.surface: A patient complains to the doctor about having an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: To prolong something tediously is to make it go on and on, a synonym of carry on.

clue.text: Director longed to be made redundant?

parts.note: to be itching to do something is to long for it

explanation.surface: A director was desperate to lose his job.
explanation.definitionFit: Ditched means dumped or got rid of, as an employee laid off is.

clue.text: Fighting that's audible in second part of tennis match

indicators.note: that's audible says the phrase is to be heard spoken, not read

parts.note: the second set of a tennis match is set two

explanation.surface: Combat that can be heard in the next stage of a tennis game.
explanation.definitionFit: A set-to is a brief fight or argument, the noun for a bout of fighting.

clue.text: Singleness of purpose as oily dirt is shifted

indicators.note: is shifted means these letters are moved round into a new order

explanation.surface: Unity of aim when greasy grime is cleared away.
explanation.definitionFit: Solidarity is unity and mutual support among a group pursuing one aim.

clue.text: Dandy lies around, demonstrating sloth maybe

indicators.note: around means these letters are turned about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A fop lounges idly about, showing laziness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sloth maybe' is a definition by example: sloth is one of the seven deadly sins.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloth is one of the seven cardinal sins of Christian teaching.

clue.text: They are at home in Oxford

definitions.text: They are at home in Oxford

parts.words: They are at home in Oxford
parts.note: Matthew Arnold called the university city the home of hopeless and forsaken ventures

explanation.surface: Things that dwell in Oxford.
explanation.walkthrough: Matthew Arnold described Oxford as the home of lost causes, a famous tag for its devotion to unfashionable beliefs.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnold's phrase calls Oxford the home of hopeless crusades, beliefs no longer winnable.

clue.text: Releasing strong emotion and whistling in the kitchen?

definitions.meaning: a kettle on the boil whistles as vapour escapes

explanation.surface: Venting one's feelings and humming a tune while cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition pictures a boiling kettle whistling on the stove.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means venting pent-up feeling; literally a kettle releases vapour with a whistle.

clue.text: Having a go at path over heather

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece over another is written before it

parts.note: a tack is a course or line taken, as by a sailing boat
ling is another name for heather

explanation.surface: Attempting a trail across the moorland.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackling a task means attempting or taking it on.

clue.text: His friend may not see him as a beast

definitions.text: His friend may not see him as a beast

parts.words: His friend may not see him as a beast
parts.note: the friend is blind, so cannot literally see the animal that leads them

explanation.surface: A companion who does not regard him as an animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may not see' reads as an opinion, but the friend is literally sightless.
explanation.definitionFit: The trained animal leads a blind owner, its companion who cannot see it.

clue.text: Slumping, needing reinforcement at end of month

indicators.note: at end of places the reinforcement after the month

parts.note: DEC is the abbreviation for December
a lining strengthens a garment or container

explanation.surface: Sagging and needing support by the month's close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needing' is only a link; 'reinforcement' is the stiffening sewn inside a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Declining means falling off or deteriorating, a synonym of slumping.

clue.text: Information about a source of lead and area for its ore

indicators.note: about says the word for information goes round the next letters

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: source of means the first letter of the word lead

explanation.surface: Data on where lead comes from and the region where it is mined.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN (British slang for information) goes about A and L (source of 'lead'), then A for area follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Galena, lead sulphide, is the chief mineral from which lead is extracted.

clue.text: Shed in which murderer's hidden body initially

indicators.note: hidden says a letter is concealed inside the murderer's name

parts.note: Cain, who killed Abel, is the first murderer in the Bible

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of body

explanation.surface: A hut where a killer has concealed a corpse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shed' looks like a verb but is the hut; B (body initially) goes inside CAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin is a small hut, the kind of simple building a shed is.

clue.text: Getting ahead of time, shift an amount of money

indicators.note: getting ahead of puts the word for shift before the time letter

parts.note: to budge is to move or shift slightly

explanation.surface: Getting in early, move a sum of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A budget is a sum allotted for spending, a set quantity of funds.

clue.text: Setback destroying pleasure — university admission denied

indicators.note: destroying means the remaining letters are broken up and rebuilt
admission denied says the university letter is refused entry, so removed

explanation.surface: A reversal that ruins enjoyment when a college place is refused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admission denied' removes U (university) from PLEASURE; 'destroying' rearranges PLEASRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A relapse is a falling back into illness or bad ways, a kind of reverse.

clue.text: Into gym goes outsize model

indicators.note: into tells us the outsize letters go inside the word for gym

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school gym class
OS is the abbreviation for outsize, a clothing size

explanation.surface: A very large model heads into the gym.
explanation.walkthrough: PE is physical education, the school gym lesson; OS is the British clothing label for outsize.
explanation.definitionFit: To pose is to sit for an artist or photographer, as a model does.

clue.text: It's clean below north American city to start with

indicators.note: to start with puts the city abbreviation at the front

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, is a city in North America
under means below

explanation.surface: Something is spotless underneath a city in North America to begin with.
explanation.definitionFit: To launder is to wash, so it means to clean.

clue.text: Journey made by fish under river

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece under another comes after it

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A trip taken by a fish beneath the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A ride is a trip in a vehicle or on horseback, a short journey.

clue.text: Restrains one's daughter in built-up area

indicators.note: in says these letters sit inside the word for built-up area

parts.note: a town is a built-up area
one's gives the letters ONES, the possessive apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Keeps a daughter under control in the city.
explanation.definitionFit: To tone down is to moderate or soften, so it means restrains.

clue.text: In the finish yours truly gets to improve

indicators.note: in says the self-reference sits inside the word for finish

parts.note: the end is the finish
yours truly is a jokey way of saying me

explanation.surface: At last I get to make myself better.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct it, so to improve it.
